slug: 2026-03-17 South Africa's National Payment System PSP licences and the 2026 payments reform

facts.fact: The National Payment System Act of 1998 regulates the payment system and gives the SARB responsibility for managing and supervising clearing and settlement; the vendor explainer says it is the current regime.

The explainer says a legislative amendment to the National Payment System Act is under review to introduce licences for non-bank providers from 2026, and that in 2025 the SARB issued an Exemption Notice and a Draft Directive on payment activities and e-money issuers; document dated by its publication date.
facts.system: National Payment System Act amendment bill
